sourceCoverage: English translation, full methods and results, original Table 1, original Figures 1-2, discussion, limitations, and printed English abstract checked.

populationLayout.rationale: The source directly reports pooled values and the primary pre/post active-water-supply comparison.

intentionallyBlankFamilies.injuryTissueType: Figure 1 percentages total 101% after rounding, so count fields were not populated or forced from incompatible percentages.
intentionallyBlankFamilies.injuryLocation: Figure 2 percentages total 101%, and the largest category combines ankle/foot; count fields were not forced from rounded or combined percentages.

directAndDerivedCaveats: Pre/post player totals 58 and 106 are transparent sums of direct annual Table 1 counts.
Contact count 88 is percentage-derived from 70% of 126; non-contact count 38 is the binary complement.
No exposure total was back-calculated from counts and rates.
The 45 consequential injuries and their incidence were not forced into time-loss fields because the definition mixes next-day treatment with inability to play.
